svg.title: Secure Document Intelligence AWS architecture and trust boundaries
svg.desc: The browser reaches CloudFront, which serves a private S3 UI and routes v1 API traffic to API Gateway and a Lambda API handler. The browser authenticates with Cognito PKCE and uploads directly to quarantine S3 with a presigned POST. S3 ObjectCreated sends SQS; GuardDuty independently scans and tags the object. The worker claims SQS, gates on the GuardDuty tag, reads quarantine, extracts with Textract or optional Bedrock, writes DynamoDB and CloudWatch, and promotes approved content to clean S3 with KMS encryption.
svg.text: AWS target · protected document review path
Terraform resources only · explicit flows and trust boundaries · cloud execution intentionally unperformed

g.text: 1 browser → CloudFront · 2 CloudFront → private UI S3 · 3 browser ↔ Cognito PKCE · 4 CloudFront /v1/* → API Gateway
5 API Gateway → API Lambda · 6 browser presigned POST → quarantine · 7 S3 ObjectCreated → SQS · 8 quarantine ↔ GuardDuty scan/tag
9 SQS → worker · 10 worker reads quarantine/tag gate · 11 worker → DynamoDB · 12 worker → clean S3 · 13 worker → Textract/Bedrock
14 worker → CloudWatch logs/alarm · 15 KMS encrypts document data paths. GuardDuty does not trigger SQS; it independently tags the object. AWS unexecuted.
